name: LiqZero
tagline: Decentralized perpetual futures exchange on Orderly Network with built-in referral rewards: create codes, share commissions, and trade with deep liquidity.
description: LiqZero.com is a next-generation decentralized exchange for perpetual futures trading, offering low fees, deep liquidity, and seamless on-chain execution through Orderly Network's omnichain order book. LiqZero adds a referral-rewards layer: users create referral codes, customize how commissions are shared with invitees, and earn from direct and indirect trades with an adjustable split. The non-custodial interface covers trading, swaps, prediction markets, portfolios, and vaults. Coverage note: execution currently runs on Orderly Network's shared infrastructure; the mapped BNB address is LiqZero's broker settlement account (an EIP-7702 delegated account), so on-chain activity metrics stay limited until a project-specific contract scope becomes trackable.
